correction: Level 3+ should not be hidden merely because it is not ready. Level 3+ should be visible in order, with readiness state controlling whether it is runnable/trusted.
what_changed: Level 3 through Level 30B are now always represented visibly inside the Continuous Run Owner stack when Continuous Run Bank is open.
If a real level panel exists, it is moved into the ordered stack.
If a real level panel does not exist yet, a visible placeholder card is created for that level.
Each Level 3+ card receives a readiness badge such as Locked / waiting or Blocked.
Readiness controls runnable/trusted state, not visibility.
Loose Level 3+ panels outside the Continuous Run Owner stack are contained only as loose/out-of-owner copies, not because they are unready.
expected_visual_result_after_refresh: After Run State Summary, Lossless Slots ZIP Import, Staging Transfer Store, Bank Project Registry, Level 1, and Level 2, there should be a Continuous Run Levels 3 through 30B section.
Level 3+ cards should be visible in order.
Level 3+ should show readiness state rather than disappear.
No loose or duplicate Level 3+ panels should appear outside the stack.
